title.en: Fable 29 — The Wind and the Sun

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: The wind and the sun quarrelled one day.
The wind said: I am stronger.
The sun said: I am not sure.

sentences.ar: הרוח אמרה: אז נבדוק את זה.
sentences.en: The wind said: then let us test it.
They saw a man walking on the road.

sentences.ar: היה לו מעיל כבד על הגוף.
sentences.en: He had a heavy coat on his body.

sentences.ar: הרוח אמרה: מי שמוריד לו את המעיל.
sentences.en: The wind said: whoever takes off his coat.
The sun said: good, you begin.
The wind blew hard on the man.

sentences.ar: האיש החזיק את המעיל בשתי ידיים.
sentences.en: The man held the coat in two hands.

sentences.ar: האיש סגר את המעיל עד הצוואר.
sentences.en: The man closed the coat up to his neck.
The wind grew tired and stopped in the end.
And then the sun came out from behind the cloud.
She shone on the road quietly.

sentences.ar: האיש הרגיש חום ופתח את המעיל.
sentences.en: The man felt warmth and opened the coat.
The sun continued a little more.

sentences.ar: האיש הוריד את המעיל ואז ישב.
sentences.en: The man took off the coat and sat down.

sentences.ar: בטוב אפשר מה שלא אפשר בכוח.
sentences.en: With kindness one can do what one cannot by force.
